Votações secretas durante uma reunião, p: Secret votes during a meeting, in person or online, with up to 20 people (for more, contact us). The same participants vote on several questions, one at a time, as the organizer opens them, including any that come up on the spot. Everyone votes on their phone, with a personal link that is valid for the whole meeting. The encrypted ballots are published on a public page that anyone can check. They are added up while still encrypted, and only the total of each vote is decrypted: no ballot is ever opened.
<p>Funciona de verdade, e qualquer pesso: It really works, and anyone can check the result, but it comes without guarantees. No legal value can be attributed to these votes. For official use, contact us.

<h2>O que esta demonstração garante, e o: What this demo guarantees, and what it does not
<li><b>Voto secreto:</b> cada cédula é c: • Secret ballot: each ballot is encrypted on the voter’s phone. Only the totals of each vote are opened. With the split key, neither the organizer nor LucentCrypto alone can read a ballot.
<li><b>Contado como votado:</b> cada pes: • Counted as cast: everyone sees their own ballot on the board, and anyone can check that the result is exactly the sum of the accepted ballots. The board has a hash chain: its history cannot be rewritten without the pages noticing.
<li><b>Quem votou aparece</b> (pelo nome: • Who voted is shown (by name or by a code, with the time); how they voted is not.
<li><b>O organizador controla a lista.</: • The organizer controls the list. Every addition and removal appears on the board. With names shown, everyone can spot an unexpected name.
<li><b>Grupos pequenos:</b> quando há po: • Small groups: when there are few participants, or when everyone votes the same way, the result can reveal how each person voted.
<li><b>Não protege:</b> quem vota sob o: • Does not protect against: someone voting while another person watches, or passing on their link; malware on the phone; losing the organizer link.
<li><b>Tudo é apagado</b> 24 horas depoi: • Everything is deleted 24 hours after the first midnight (Brasília time) following the end of the meeting. A downloaded record can still be checked.
<p>Esta página é uma demonstração, feita: This page is a demo, made in good faith and with care. It is offered “as is”, without warranty of any kind, including of operation, security or fitness for a particular purpose. No legal value can be attributed to these votes. The authors and LucentCrypto accept no liability for any damage arising from its use. The code has not yet been independently audited.
